Palestine College of Nursing and Midwifery

📍 Khan Yunis, Khan Yunis
College Khan Yunis Operational

The Palestine College of Nursing and Midwifery in Khan Yunis is a public institution dedicated to training nursing and midwifery professionals for Gaza's healthcare system. Given the severe shortage of healthcare workers in the Strip, it played a critical role in building clinical capacity for Gazan hospitals and health centres.
